mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving residential investment and consumer confidence, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a strong labor market supported by accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to market concerns about economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which typically boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls by at least 0.2% month-over-month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals robust consumer spending, which typically precedes higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 0.5% MoM, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% month-over-month and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 0.5%) indicates a hawkish monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM and FEDFUNDS >= 0.5%) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.
